description:
Multiple Locations: Collegeville – PA/ Peapack, NJ/ Sterling, VA 
 Java developer with strong Spring Framework and Database skills required to develop custom solutions for Access Certification web application. Angular 2 Front end skills preferred. 
 Should be able to work independently, developing code of high quality 
 Develop a web application with predominantly micro services that interact with databases 
 Contribute to the design of the application 
 Develop unit/integration/system testing scripts 
 Ability to do builds/deployment using Continuous Build/Integration tools 
 Identity and Access management Group. Interactions with Product and Delivery manager/Architect/Lead developer/Scrum master 
 Java 8 
 Strong Spring Framework (version 4 or above) skills (Spring Boot, JPA, Batch, Integration/XD, Restful Services etc.) 
 Hibernate 4 or above 
 Oracle 12, Stored procedures 
 Angular 2 or above to develop Single Page Web applications/ HTML5 
 Testing tools like Selenium 
 Continuous Build like Team City/Jenkins 
 Agile Practice Preferred. 
 

 What is the minimum education experience required?: 
 • 8-10 years’ experience
• B.S. in Computer Science/Engineering or related fields
• Certification in Java/Spring/Oracle preferred
